richiami.difetto: In the case of tipper semi-trailers (S.KI) from a limited production period the bolted connection of the kingpin may not correspond to the prescribed torque. In extreme cases this can result in the tipper semi-trailer becoming separated from the tractor unit.
richiami.rimedio: To avoid damage it is necessary that the kingpin bolts be inspected and if necessary retightened by an authorised Schmitz Cargobull service partner.
richiami.titolo: Inspection of Kingpin Bolted Connection F329

richiami.difetto: It has been identified during trials that in situations of extremely heavy use it may be possible for a crack to develop in the sem-i trailer bed plate just ahead of the king pin. If a crack does develop and is ignored then ultimately the risk exists that the king pin could be torn away.
richiami.rimedio: The subject area of the bed plate will be modified as necessary.
